name: MyAccount Studio
author: Luda Digital

sections.description:
MyAccount Studio transforms the default WooCommerce My Account page into a clean, modern, user‑friendly dashboard with a card-based layout.

Designed for store owners who care about user experience, MyAccount Studio gives you a polished, branded account page out of the box — no coding required.

Free Features

  • Modern card-based dashboard layout
  • Personalized welcome header with customer display name
  • Account overview with order count
  • Recent orders summary
  • Quick links to common account actions (Orders, Addresses, Account Details)
  • Optional “Contact Support” button with custom URL
  • Clean navigation with Dashicons
  • Toggle the “My account” page header on or off
  • Toggle the Welcome Back header on or off
  • Responsive design for all screen sizes
  • Lightweight and performance‑focused
  • Works with any WooCommerce-compatible theme

MyAccount Studio Pro

Looking for more control? Upgrade to MyAccount Studio Pro for advanced customization:

  • Full Appearance Customization — Customize card backgrounds, text colors, accent colors, link colors, and hover states with color pickers.
  • Advanced Icon Controls — Choose between Dashicons, Font Awesome, or upload your own custom icons for each endpoint. Customize icon colors, hover colors, and sizes.
  • Custom Endpoint Subtext — Add helpful descriptions under each account menu item.
  • Order Status Badges — Display color-coded badges for order statuses (Processing, Completed, On Hold, etc.).
  • Profile Completeness Bar — Show customers a progress bar encouraging them to complete their profile.
  • Last Login Timestamp — Display when the customer last logged in.
  • Member Since Block — Show the customer’s registration date.
  • Need Help? Block — A customizable support card with custom title and message.
  • Customizable Welcome Text — Personalize the welcome header with your own text and the {name} placeholder.
  • Customizable Support Button — Change the support button label to match your brand voice.
  • Dark Mode — Automatic dark mode support for users who prefer it (OS-based).
  • Custom CSS — Add your own CSS overrides directly from the settings panel.

Upgrade to MyAccount Studio Pro

Why MyAccount Studio?

The WooCommerce My Account page is one of the most important customer touchpoints — yet it’s often overlooked. MyAccount Studio helps you create a polished, branded experience that improves clarity, trust, and usability.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/myaccount-studio/, or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → MyAccount Studio to customize your dashboard.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. MyAccount Studio is built on top of the WooCommerce My Account template and requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

Does this plugin require coding?

No. Everything is controlled through a clean, intuitive settings panel.

Does this plugin work with all themes?

Yes — any theme that supports WooCommerce’s My Account template will work.

Will this slow down my site?

No. MyAccount Studio is lightweight and optimized for performance.

Is there a Pro version?

Yes. MyAccount Studio Pro adds full color customization, advanced icon controls, order status badges, profile completeness, dark mode, custom CSS, and more. Learn more.
